_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic page, spare knowing ink line with soft watercolor in muted ochre, slate blue and misty sea-foam green, Pacific Northwest coastal light, economy of line, quiet composition. model sheet of a woman in her mid-forties with dark hair streaked gray and no makeup, a worn navy rain jacket, jeans and olive rubber boots, holding a white ceramic mug in both hands; front, profile, seated on a dock; expression heads: clear, unhurried, wry, at rest; labeled CHLOE 2024. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, saturated color, neon, anime, busy composition, watermark, extra fingers
